title.en: How a Model Actually Uses a Tool

subtitle.zh: AI-FDE 转型之路 · AI 工程 06-Tool-Calling 原理
subtitle.en: The AI-FDE Transition Path · AI Engineering 06 — Tool Calling, Under the Hood

summary.zh: 模型从头到尾没有调用过任何工具，它只输出一段「我要调什么、参数是什么」的文本。把四轮完整报文摊开，看清执行、回填、成本和 MCP 的边界。
summary.en: The model never calls a tool. It only emits text saying what it wants to call and with which arguments. A four-round request walkthrough shows execution, result injection, cost and where MCP actually fits.
